nom: RoC Multi Correxion Revive + Glow Vitamin C Eye Balm Stick

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their under-eye area as sensitive, including one prone to dryness, report no irritation and good hydration; one reviewer who says she does not normally have sensitive skin developed red, itchy bumps around her eyes after just a few days of use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, less crepiness, and a firmer, more lifted feel around the eyes, with some saying it makes them look noticeably younger within a week or two of use; one reviewer confirms it works as claimed but dislikes the tightening sensation enough that she wouldn't repurchase, and a few others used it too briefly to notice any change to their lines.
concerns.dehydration: This is the product's most consistently reported effect: reviewers, including ones with dry, sensitive under-eyes, describe immediate and lasting hydration, a plumper feel, and softer skin, often from the first use; no reviewer reports it failing to hydrate, though a handful say they couldn't tell if it was doing anything after only a few uses.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation at all, including one with sensitive skin who says her eyes no longer wake up feeling irritated; one reviewer had the opposite reaction, developing red, itchy bumps around her eyes after a few days despite not normally having sensitive skin.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visibly lighter, less noticeable dark circles within days to a couple of weeks, and one specifically credits it with fading sun damage around her eyes; a handful disagree, saying they saw no visible difference in their dark circles even after consistent use.

extraits.texte: I would NOT recommend- I do not have sensitive skin - used product once a day for a few days now I have red itchy bumps around my eyes !!!

I received this product for free to review, but honestly, I would've bought it myself! I love eye balms, but my under-eyes can be sensitive and prone to dryness. This gave me zero negative reaction and left my under-eyes feeling super hydrated. Definitely a win!

The RoC Multi Correxion Revive + Glow Eye Balm has quickly become a favorite in my routine. I love the convenient stick applicator — it's mess-free and so easy to swipe on in the morning or whenever my under-eyes need a boost. It feels cooling and hydrating on contact and leaves a subtle dewy finish that makes a great base for concealer (no more creasing!). I've noticed my under-eyes look brighter and less puffy, especially after consistent use. Dark circles appear softer, and the area feels smoother overall. A little goes a long way, and the fragrance-free formula is gentle on my sensitive skin. Highly recommend if you want quick brightening without a heavy cream!

I have mixed feelings about this eye balm. Do I think it works? Absolutely. It tightens and refreshes and illuminates the area around my eyes, and makes me look more wide awake, and dare I say, younger. It does everything that it claims to do, and more. It is non-scented, easy-to-apply, is not greasy or oily or heavy, and can be worn alone or under makeup. I think it would be the perfect product for many, many people. But unfortunately, I don't think that I would personally buy it again. I just don't enjoy the "tightening" sensation under my eyes. So even though the product does what it claims to do, that tightening sensation offsets, for me, the benefits of this product. **I received this product free for review, but all opinions are my own.

I received the RoC Multi Correxion Revive + Glow Eye Balm for free in exchange for my honest review. I absolutely love this product; the stick packaging is so innovative and makes application incredibly easy, especially when I'm on the go. I have used in alone and also as a base for my under eye concealer. This diminishes the look of my fine lines and dryness under my eyes. This doesn't make my eyes tear. It doesn't feel greasy and it lasts a long time. I have also used this on lines on my mouth area from when I was a smoker. I love it!
